book.name: Tesalonika
book.title: Poldi Tesalonika Habu Yengele Hibi Monic Hatacmac Kwelengkewec

content: Sugucnele yowa-siduc sugulelu hikedaic

Ngic hae-gbafocnonggeng, yanguc taockelu mibeng ngagening. Ngenge nongele ailu yanguc milockedaing, nonge Sugucnele yowa mibeng sawelu biyac sugulelu hikeyackedaic. Aime ngic-ngigac aling gocne yenge yowa yogo ngagelu Sugucne bafelu gadaing. Ngengela fikewec, silicine ingucnehac ngic-ngigac gocne yengela fikelu hikedaic.

Ngic-ngigac bocyac yenge ngage-ngagesingngineng mikac, inguc gagabiyeng. Ilec ngic-ngigac sowacneholec nga bikickolec yengi mi basowalecnubabong Wapongti yengele molewacni baicnubadaic, ngenge yogolec milockedaing.
Aime Sugucne ye yowaine micaigac yogo balaibelu basanangngebame Kindololo fileinedi mi basowalecngebanale asa bacngebacaigac.
Nonge Sugucnele ailu ngengele yanguc ngagepangkegabeleng. Nonge yowa milu edocngebalu basanangngebabeng, ngenge yogo balaibelu gagaing, ailu gadaingte.
Gaebongka Sugucnedi kwelenginang pasi bame Wapongte kwele-angacti somecngebame Kristo ingucnehac sanangkelu gadabiyeng.
Deboc hadeng bole baibeng

Ngic hae-gbafocnonggeng, ngic hae-gba gocne yenge oyong gabong yefe weduyeleibeng, yogo mi balaibegabiyeng. Ngenge ngic hae-gba ingucne yengele emewa mi gadabiyeng. Nonge yogo Sugucnenonggeng Yesu Kristole wacka edocngebalu basanangngebagabeleng.
Aime nonge gaibeng, ngenge silicine yogohac ganingte ngagebeng madickegac, ngenge ngengung yogo ngagegaing. Aime ngengeholec gaibeng, iwa oyong monic mi gaibeng, miyac.
Nonge ngengele hewacka galu ngic monictacni nosing fuline mikac moc balu mi nolu gaibeng. Nonge umac gocne ngeledabelengkale, molenonggengti deboc hadeng soctepecka doic-bole sugucnehac balu gaibeng.
Nonge Wapongte bolele fuli nalic babeng madickedeckalesoc, aime yogo hegilelu aibaba aiibeng, yogo ngengi nganilu balaibeningte aiibeng.
Aime ngengeholec gaibeng, iwa yefe-yowa yanguc edocngebaibeng, “Ngic monic ye bole mi badaictewa, ye nosingka bafickenogale mi ngagedaing.”
Nonge inguc milu dameng monickabac siduc monic yanguc ngageibeng, ngengelacni ngic gocne yenge bole mi balu oyong gacaigaing. Ailu monicte bole fengka haulu moc domalu nganicebacaigaing.
Nonge Sugucne Yesu Kristole wacka ngic ingucne yenge mibasanang aiyelelu yowa sanangne yanguc edocebadabelengte, “Ngenge gagangineng bafuwanogale madicne ngiyelu socte bole badabiyeng.”
Ngic hae-gbafocnonggeng, ngenge aibaba madicne ainogale kwelenginengti mi takicngebadaic.
Aime nonge yowa yago hibiwa kwelengkengelegabeleng, monicti yowa yogo mi balaibedaictewa, ngenge yeholec mi gadabiyeng. Inguc aibong ye gameedaicte.
Ailu ngengi ngic monic ingucne ngaba mi aicnodabiyeng, miyac. Ye agong holecnobong ngengele ngic hae-gba aidaic.
Mimi-madic yowa
Sugucne kwele-mogung fileine ye yeuctihac damengsoc yefe haicine monic-monicka kwele-mogung ngeledaic. Ye sasawa ngengeholec gadaic.
Na Pol, naneuctihac molenedi wenac-madic hibine kwelengkengelegabac. Ngic-ngigac sasawadi nale mole hibile maaine nganilu noine ngageningte inguc kwelengkecaigabac.
Sugucnenonggeng Yesu Kristole kwele-madicti ngengeholec fadaic. Yogo foinac.
